seo.title: Best Rooftop Bars in Tallinn (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover Tallinn's top 12 rooftop bars for 2026! Sip craft cocktails and local beers with breathtaking views over fairy-tale spires and modern cityscapes. Find your perfect elevated escape.

hero.subtitle: Tallinn's vibrant rooftop bar scene offers unparalleled views of its medieval Old Town and bustling modern districts, perfect for enjoying a refreshing drink as the sun sets over the Baltic Sea.

picks.name: Horisont Restaurant & Bar
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Perched on the 30th floor of Swissôtel Tallinn, Horisont offers a truly luxurious experience with unparalleled 360-degree views of the Old Town, Baltic Sea, and city skyline. Known for its sophisticated cocktails and gourmet European cuisine, it's the perfect spot for a special occasion or an unforgettable sunset drink.
picks.whatToOrder: A bespoke craft cocktail from their extensive menu, paired with the Tasting Menu for a full culinary journey.
picks.insiderTip: Book a window table in advance, especially for sunset. Their outdoor terrace is seasonal but provides fresh air with the same incredible views.
picks.redditQuote: "Horisont at Swissôtel is ridiculously good. Went there for my anniversary and the views alone were worth it, cocktails were amazing too. Pricey but worth the splurge."

picks.name: Lounge 24
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located on the 11th floor of the Radisson Collection Tallinn, Lounge 24 boasts a stylish interior and a spacious outdoor terrace offering stunning views of the city. It's a popular spot for both locals and tourists, serving a diverse menu of international snacks, light meals, and a creative cocktail list in a vibrant atmosphere.
picks.whatToOrder: Their signature 'Tallinn Sunrise' cocktail and a selection of their Asian-inspired small plates.
picks.insiderTip: Great for pre-dinner drinks. The terrace can get busy, so arrive a bit earlier to snag a good spot outside.
picks.redditQuote: "Lounge 24 has some seriously good views and their bar snacks are surprisingly tasty. Perfect chill spot after a long day exploring Tallinn."

picks.name: Fotografiska Tallinn Rooftop Café & Bar
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Situated atop the Fotografiska museum, this rooftop bar offers a unique blend of art, culture, and panoramic views of the industrial-chic Telliskivi district and Old Town spires. With a strong focus on sustainability, their menu features delicious vegan-friendly dishes and a well-curated selection of organic wines and craft beers.
picks.whatToOrder: One of their seasonal vegan flatbreads and a local craft beer or natural wine.
picks.insiderTip: Combine your visit with an exhibition at Fotografiska for a full cultural experience. It's especially lively during summer evenings with live music.
picks.redditQuote: "Fotografiska's rooftop is my favorite spot in Telliskivi. The atmosphere is always buzzing, the vegan food is fantastic, and you get a cool view of the Old Town peeking out."

picks.name: Cloudbar
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Perched high on the 12th floor of the Radisson Blu Sky Hotel, Cloudbar lives up to its name with a sleek, modern design and expansive windows offering dramatic city views. It's a prime destination for expertly crafted cocktails, a sophisticated wine list, and a refined selection of bar bites in an upscale, yet relaxed, setting.
picks.whatToOrder: A classic Negroni or one of their house special cocktails, along with the truffle fries.
picks.insiderTip: Great for a post-work drink or a romantic evening. The interior feels like you're floating above the city, even without an open terrace.
picks.redditQuote: "Cloudbar at the Radisson Blu Sky is a hidden gem. Super chic, killer cocktails, and you feel like you're on top of the world looking out over Tallinn. Definitely recommend."

picks.name: KAIF Rooftop
picks.whyItMadeTheList: KAIF Rooftop brings a vibrant, Mediterranean-inspired atmosphere to the trendy Rotermanni Quarter. This seasonal hotspot is known for its lively music, delicious light bites, and refreshing cocktails. It offers fantastic views of the unique architecture of Rotermanni and glimpses of the Old Town, making it a perfect summer evening destination.
picks.whatToOrder: Their Aperol Spritz or a custom gin & tonic, complemented by their hummus platter.
picks.insiderTip: Check their social media for DJ sets and special events – KAIF often hosts lively parties. It's a very popular summer venue, so expect a crowd.
picks.redditQuote: "KAIF Rooftop is such a vibe in summer! Great music, good drinks, and that Rotermanni view is surprisingly cool. Just wish it was open all year."

picks.name: Skybar by O'Learys
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located on the 6th floor of the Hilton Tallinn Park, Skybar by O'Learys offers a more casual rooftop experience with an American sports bar theme. Enjoy classic pub fare, a wide selection of beers, and cocktails while catching a game on one of their many screens, all against the backdrop of city views and Kadriorg Park.
picks.whatToOrder: A classic burger and a local Saku beer, or their signature 'Skybar Spritz'.
picks.insiderTip: A great choice if you're looking for a relaxed atmosphere or want to watch a sporting event. Their outdoor terrace is spacious and often less crowded than other spots.
picks.redditQuote: "O'Learys Skybar is surprisingly good for a chain. The terrace has decent views and it's a chill place to grab a beer without the pretense of some other rooftop bars."

picks.name: The Park Lounge & Bar
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Situated on the 26th floor of the Radisson Blu Hotel Olümpia, The Park Lounge & Bar offers a refined setting with spectacular panoramic views. While primarily a lounge with large windows, it features a small outdoor section seasonally, providing a breathtaking vantage point for cocktails and light bites above the city. It’s perfect for a sophisticated yet comfortable evening.
picks.whatToOrder: One of their expertly mixed gin cocktails or a glass of sparkling wine, accompanied by their artisan cheese board.
picks.insiderTip: Visit around sunset for incredible photo opportunities. The lounge is often quieter than other hotel bars, making it ideal for conversation.
picks.redditQuote: "The Park Lounge at Radisson Olümpia has seriously underrated views. It’s not a full outdoor rooftop, but you feel so high up and the cocktails are top-notch."

picks.name: The Living Room
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Found on an elevated terrace level of Hotel L'Embitu, The Living Room is a chic garden terrace bar that offers a lush, secluded escape with views over the surrounding city architecture. It’s a beautifully designed space, ideal for enjoying a glass of fine wine, signature cocktails, and Mediterranean-inspired snacks in a relaxed, elegant environment.
picks.whatToOrder: A glass of crisp Sauvignon Blanc from their curated wine list and their olive selection.
picks.insiderTip: This spot feels more like a hidden garden oasis than a typical rooftop, offering a unique ambiance. Great for a quieter, more intimate evening.
picks.redditQuote: "Hotel L'Embitu's 'The Living Room' terrace is so pretty! It's not sky-high but has a lovely elevated feel and the cocktails are amazing. Very classy."

picks.name: Viru Centre Rooftop Cafe & Bar
picks.whyItMadeTheList: This seasonal rooftop cafe and bar, located on top of the Viru Centre shopping mall, is a fantastic budget-friendly option for panoramic city views. It offers a relaxed, casual atmosphere, perfect for grabbing a quick coffee, a refreshing beer, or a light snack while enjoying a unique perspective of Tallinn's bustling heart and surrounding landmarks.
picks.whatToOrder: A local Estonian beer and a scoop of ice cream on a sunny day.
picks.insiderTip: This spot is very popular with locals during summer, especially for its affordability and central location. It's often referred to simply as 'Katusekohvik' (Rooftop Cafe).
picks.redditQuote: "The Viru Centre rooftop is great for a casual summer beer with friends. Nothing fancy, but the views are surprisingly good for the price!"

picks.name: Terrass Restaurant & Bar
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Perched on a higher floor of the Nordic Hotel Forum, Terrass Restaurant & Bar offers a spacious outdoor terrace that comes alive in warmer months. While it serves as a breakfast area, it transforms into a lively bar and dining spot in the evenings, offering good views of the city center and occasional glimpses of the Old Town. It's known for its relaxed ambiance and solid international menu.
picks.whatToOrder: Their refreshing house lemonade or a classic gin & tonic, with some easy-to-share appetizers.
picks.insiderTip: This is a great option if you're staying nearby and want a convenient, elevated outdoor spot without going too far. Check for their themed evening menus.
picks.redditQuote: "Nordic Hotel Forum's Terrass is actually a pretty solid spot for an evening drink. Not super high up, but the outdoor area is comfortable and you can watch the city life below."

picks.name: VEGAS Grill & Bar
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located on the 10th floor of the modern Tallink City Hotel, VEGAS Grill & Bar boasts a vibrant atmosphere inspired by Las Vegas. It features a sleek interior and a dynamic outdoor terrace with views stretching across the city, making it a lively spot for cocktails, premium grilled dishes, and a fun night out.
picks.whatToOrder: A classic steak from the grill and a 'Viva Las Vegas' signature cocktail.
picks.insiderTip: Known for its energetic ambiance, especially on weekends. It's a good choice for groups looking for a vibrant dining and drinking experience with a view.
picks.redditQuote: "VEGAS at Tallink City Hotel is surprisingly good. Didn't expect much from a hotel bar but the terrace views are legit and they make a mean Old Fashioned."

picks.name: Old Town Roof Terrace Bar (Hotel St. Olav)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Tucked away within the historic Hotel St. Olav in the heart of the Old Town, this charming and often seasonal roof terrace bar offers an intimate experience with unparalleled close-up views of Tallinn's fairy-tale spires and red rooftops. It's a quieter spot, ideal for soaking in the medieval ambiance with a glass of wine or a simple cocktail.
picks.whatToOrder: A glass of local sparkling wine (vahuvein) and a light cheese or olive platter.
picks.insiderTip: Due to its Old Town location, access can be a bit tricky, but the unique perspective is worth it. It's a smaller terrace, so it feels very exclusive.
picks.redditQuote: "Found this tiny roof terrace at Hotel St. Olav in Old Town, and wow, the view of the spires was just magical. Perfect for a quiet drink away from the crowds."

faq.question: What is the best time of year to visit Tallinn's rooftop bars?
faq.answer: The ideal time to enjoy Tallinn's rooftop bars is during the warmer months, from late May to early September. This is when most outdoor terraces are fully open, and the long daylight hours offer spectacular sunset views. Some indoor rooftop bars are excellent year-round.

faq.question: Do I need reservations for rooftop bars in Tallinn?
faq.answer: For upscale rooftop restaurants and popular bars like Horisont or Lounge 24, especially on weekends or for sunset views, reservations are highly recommended. More casual spots like Viru Centre Rooftop Cafe generally don't require them, but it's always wise to check their website.

faq.question: Are there non-alcoholic options available at these rooftop bars?
faq.answer: Yes, most rooftop bars in Tallinn offer a good selection of non-alcoholic beverages, including creative mocktails, freshly squeezed juices, artisanal sodas, and various coffees and teas. Many also serve food, making them suitable for non-drinkers or those looking for a light meal.

faq.question: What kind of dress code should I expect?
faq.answer: Dress codes vary. Upscale establishments like Horisont and Lounge 24 often require smart casual attire (no shorts or flip-flops), while places like Skybar by O'Learys or Viru Centre Rooftop Cafe are more relaxed. It's always a good idea to check the venue's specific guidelines if you're unsure.

faq.question: Which rooftop bars offer the best views of Tallinn's Old Town?
faq.answer: For breathtaking Old Town views, Horisont Restaurant & Bar, Fotografiska Tallinn Rooftop Café & Bar (from a unique angle), and the Old Town Roof Terrace Bar (Hotel St. Olav) are top choices. Lounge 24 and The Park Lounge & Bar also offer great perspectives with glimpses of the historic district.

faq.question: Are Tallinn's rooftop bars generally kid-friendly?
faq.answer: While many rooftop cafes and bars welcome families during the day, they transition to a more adult-oriented atmosphere in the evenings. Fotografiska's rooftop, being a café, might be more accommodating for families earlier in the day. High-end bars or those with a strong cocktail focus are generally less suitable for children, especially after sunset.

methodology: Our selection of Tallinn's best rooftop bars for 2026 was curated through extensive local research, expert reviews, and current trend analysis, focusing on establishments offering exceptional panoramic views, quality cocktails and beverages, inviting atmosphere, and consistent service. We prioritized venues with genuine rooftop or elevated outdoor terrace experiences, ensuring a mix of luxury, casual, and unique cultural settings across the city.
